play_equipment.detail: A round dark object sits at the upper left, but it is not clearly on the central lot and is probably a cover or other feature, so it is not counted.

detached_structure.detail: The house has a multi-part roofline with an extension toward the east. It does not clearly read as a separate outbuilding.

signals.notes: The house is partly hidden by large mature trees on several sides. A single blue car is parked on the narrow driveway running south to the street. The two black cars at the top belong to the neighboring lot.
